[Story]
Lisa is a programmer, and one day she finds an awesome keyboard online that she really wants to buy. However, at the company's annual party, Lisa was voted best employee and was given a reward, a set of top-of-the-line gaming peripherals that she had always dreamed of. Lisa then decides to spend her allowance on more games.

[Question]
What will Lisa do after purchasing the game?        

[Candidate Answers]
A. Lisa buys more gaming peripherals.
B. Lisa shows her game to her colleagues.
C. Lisa gives up the game and focuses on work.
D. Lisa no longer buys that keyboard.
